title: StockSmart Bin and Par Level Allowances, Par Reviews and Special Stock Limits
content:
**Annex B to the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program terms — bins, par levels and special stock**

The following allowances and figures apply per program, by tier.

| Figure | Self-Scan | Monthly Service | Biweekly Service | Weekly Service | Twice-Weekly Service | Onsite Storeroom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| New bins the customer may ask to add in a calendar month without a bin setup fee | 5 | 10 | 25 | 50 | 100 | 250 |
| Setup fee per new bin added beyond the monthly included adds, USD | 4.50 | 4.50 | 3.50 | 2.50 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Customer-requested par level changes per calendar month without a fee | 5 | 10 | 20 | 40 | 80 | 200 |
| Fee per par level change beyond the included changes, USD | 2.00 | 2.00 | 1.50 | 1.00 | 0.50 | 0.00 |
| Months between Corbett par level reviews (0 means no scheduled review) | 0 | 6 | 6 | 3 | 3 | 1 |
| Months without any replenishment or consumption after which a bin is removed at the par review | 12 | 12 | 12 | 9 | 9 | 6 |
| Non-catalog items Corbett stocks specially for the program | 0 | 10 | 25 | 50 | 100 | 300 |
| Fee per bin or label replaced because of customer damage, USD | 8.50 | 8.50 | 7.50 | 6.50 | 5.00 | 0.00 |

The column headings name StockSmart Self-Scan, StockSmart Monthly Service, StockSmart Biweekly Service, StockSmart Weekly Service, StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service and StockSmart Onsite Storeroom.

### Notes

- A fee figure of 0.00 means the tier never charges that fee.
- StockSmart Self-Scan has no scheduled par level review (0 months) and stocks no special non-catalog items (0).
- The included adds and included changes are counts per calendar month.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical StockSmart Biweekly Service program has 20 par level changes in a calendar month within its allowance of 20; a 21st change in the same month lies beyond the allowance and carries 1.50.
